token.hint: A personal access token (classic) with the “read:user”, “repo” and “read:org” permissions: it loads your public repositories (those of your organizations too) and your account with private contributions. Without “repo” private contributions are counted but not split by type; without “read:org” organizations with hidden membership are left out.
token.label: Personal access token
